one_liner: Financial data connectivity platform that links bank accounts to apps for transactions, balances, and identity data.

auth.evidence_quote: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a client_id and secret. These may be sent either in the request body or in the headers PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET.
auth.notes: Plaid also uses Link (a client-side flow with access_token per end-user item) but developer-side API auth is client_id/secret, not OAuth2 in the traditional sense.

access.evidence_quote: You can request Production API access via the Dashboard.
access.notes: Sandbox environment is free and self-serve; moving to Production requires Plaid's approval process via the Dashboard.

api.evidence_quote: The Sandbox environment supports only test Items.
api.notes: Did not verify an official Plaid MCP server within call budget.

verdict.rationale: Sandbox is self-serve and free, but real production access to other users' bank data requires Plaid's approval process.
